slots.label: أمام
slots.pose_ar: وجه وكتفين من قدّام والنظر للكاميرا. أول وضعية بتتولّد وباقي الوضعيات بتنبني عليها.

prompt.text:
CHARACTER REFERENCE SHEET — FRONT. Photorealistic studio photo of the SAME person in every view of this sheet.
Person: 32-year-old woman, دافئة، واثقة.
Skin: خمرية. Hair: بني داكن. Regional look: ملامح شامية.
Outfit (identical in every view): بلوزة كحلية وحجاب بيج.
Pose: Head-and-shoulders portrait, facing the camera straight-on with eyes to the lens, relaxed friendly neutral expression, camera at eye level (85mm look).
Background & light (identical for every view): plain light-gray seamless background, soft even studio lighting, no shadow on the background.
Rules: one person only; no text, logos, watermarks, props or jewelry changes; natural skin texture, no beauty filters or retouching that alters identity.
